title: Early in the Morning Album Cover
coreRelationships: The band members are centrally positioned, anchoring the composition.
The typography forms an arc, framing the upper portion of the image and drawing attention to the title.
The muted color palette of the landscape contrasts with the slightly more vibrant, yet still earthy, tones of the band's clothing and the title text.
The horizontal line of the horizon separates the land and sea, providing a backdrop for the figures.
